title: Index of a subgroup image under a finite group surjection
statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be finite groups [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set], let $\rho:G\to H$ be a surjective group homomorphism (so $\rho(xy)=\rho(x)\rho(y)$), and let $L\leq G$ be a subgroup. Write $J=\rho(L)\leq H$. For a subgroup $B\leq A$, write $[A:B]$ for the number of left cosets of $B$ in $A$, and $|A|$ for the number of elements of $A$. Then $[H:J]\mid[G:L]$ and $|J|[H:J]=|H|$.
